description: A joint-friendly unilateral leg exercise that targets quads, hamstrings, and glutes with high stability.
setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, hands on hips or clasped at chest level.
steps: Take a controlled step backward with one leg onto the ball of your rear foot.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent at roughly 90-degree angles and rear knee hovers above the floor.
Push firmly through the front heel to drive back up to the starting position.
cues: Keep your front knee stacked directly above your ankle
Maintain an upright torso with weight distributed through the front heel

mistakes.mistake: Slamming back knee onto the hard floor
mistakes.fix: Control descent and gently tap or hover the knee one inch off the ground

mistakes.mistake: Stepping backward directly in line with front foot like a tightrope
mistakes.fix: Keep feet hip-width apart like train tracks for balance

rep_standard: Begins standing tall with hips extended, rear knee hovers or light taps floor, and finishes with return to standing feet together.
